claims.detail: Committed exemplar: backup window documented but geo-redundancy flags disabled on primary storage accounts.

findings.description: Backup retention and RPO targets are not evidenced in the architecture pack for the production OLTP database tier.
findings.recommendation: Publish RPO/RTO decisions and attach Azure SQL automated backup exports or third-party vault references.

findings.description: Geo-redundant storage is disabled while marketing pages imply multi-site availability for transactional APIs.
findings.recommendation: Either enable paired-region storage patterns or narrow availability claims in external communications.
